text_block_list.text:
I bumped into Symboli Rudolf in front of the school gates
just as she was about to head out.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer.
What a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Call it... a daily dose of learning about society.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Say, if you're free,
why don't you come along with me?
I had no particular plans, so I decided to accompany Symboli Rudolf.
The place Symboli Rudolf brought me to was the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now then, I wonder what kind of festivities we have in store today.
choice_data_list: So you came to watch the race?
Did you come to watch the race?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, I'm here for something else today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Normally, a great deal of things besides racing
take place here.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
From there, I can also gain a fresh perspective
on how the public feels about Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And so, that's why I frequently go on
inspection tours like this.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Alright, since we're here, why don't I have you pick for me today, Trainer-kun?

Prompted by Symboli Rudolf, I looked at the bulletin board.
Several posters for upcoming events were pinned up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Pick whatever interests you.
Let's go take part in it."
Looking around, two events caught my interest.
choice_data_list: Special Exhibition of World-Renowned Uma Musume

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, a grandstand cleaning volunteer event, is it?
Then let us be on our way!

A wide variety of people, young and old, men and women alike,
were taking part in the volunteer work alongside us.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you the Student Council President of Tracen Academy?
Hello there!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hello.
It's a pleasure to be working with you today.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman
text_block_list.text:
Likewise. After all, you girls always
bring me so much joy.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Woman
text_block_list.text: "I joined in on the cleaning today as a token of my gratitude as well."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I am—deeply humbled.
It truly braces my resolve.

During the cleanup, Symboli Rudolf
interacted with various participants.

Every one of the participants
holds deep feelings toward the Twinkle Series...
Every time Symboli Rudolf listened to their stories, she wore a serious, yet genuinely happy expression.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun.
Thank you for accompanying me today.
choice_data_list: That was a great learning experience.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That's good to hear.
I too gained a valuable lesson today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"The fact that even outside of race time,
we Umamusume are supported by our fans."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Looking out at the stands from the track,
my mindset has changed once again."

The scenery she strives to cherish.
It was a day that offered a glimpse into a piece of it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A limited-time special exhibition...
Looks like it starts today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Looks like it'll be quite a spectacle.
Let's head over right away.

Entering the venue together, it was immediately clear
just how much effort had been put into the exhibition.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hoh. It comprehensively covers the exploits of renowned Umamusume across various nations, spanning racing history and even the surrounding cultural history...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's almost a shame this isn't a permanent exhibit.
You can really feel the organizer's passion for Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Which makes the lack of publicity all the more regrettable.
Is there anything we can do to help—
As she said that, Symboli Rudolf looked at the exhibit with an air of genuine enjoyment.

Listening to her explanations along the way,
I thoroughly enjoyed the special exhibition.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The sun has completely set, has it?
Still, it was extremely worthwhile.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The races we run are not merely athletic competitions.
They are the history of Umamusume, their culture, and—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It is a mighty river of time and emotions... flowing all the way to the "now" where the fans and we stand together.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As for this exhibition,
I shall arrange to spread the word across the academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun.
Thank you for accompanying me today.
choice_data_list: That was a great learning experience.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's good to hear.
It was a day that offered a glimpse into Symboli Rudolf's insatiable eagerness to learn.
